note: Vestibule just inside the porch's front door. Feminine left (boy pouring goo down a gutter, woman seated on a stone base eating cheese, fish in the wall crack, grandma bricklayer's arch), the two flatmates tugging one key (colocataire, either gender) at the centre, masculine right (man in a vest with a little bull, gnome under a glass dome, builder hugging the foundation stone, estate agent with the house mobile, bear shown to the guest bed). Front door at the left back to the front garden; white double door to the entrance hall; stone archway at the right into the corridor.
